soundness_flags.label: def:model-class; def:honest-procedures; def:minimax-radius
soundness_flags.one_line: The class is a class of laws of full Y while its coverage event and risk use a latent L_n that is not determined by such a law: on W_n, different rank-r L_n and D_n can yield the same law of Y_n, so honesty and rho_star are not presently functionals of the indexed experiment.

soundness_flags.label: def:wedge-spectral-procedure; thm:wedge-certificate
soundness_flags.one_line: WSVD is not yet a defined algorithm: its overlap graph, synchronization gauge/edge rule, conditional Gaussian law, and Davis--Kahan remainder are unspecified, so Rhat_alpha,n and the polynomial-time claim have no determinate mathematical object.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2--3, §1.1; pp. 5--7, §§2.1--2.3; p. 11, Theorem 1 and Proposition 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies irreversible staggered adoption, reduces the design to four-block subproblems, proves entrywise Gaussian approximation and prescribed entrywise coverage, and describes Theorem 2 as an instance-wise lower-bound comparison.
The paper studies a deterministic square missing block and nuclear-norm minimization; Theorems 3.4--3.5 characterize its worst-case Frobenius/RMSE residual under their approximately-low-rank setup.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1507.03829v1 corroborating preprint; cited EJS version was not directly accessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper concerns Gaussian-design trace regression, nuclear/Frobenius detection boundaries, and impossibility of rank-adaptive honest nuclear confidence sets, rather than deterministic coordinate wedges.
The paper gives rate-optimal recovery of an average treatment effect for general intervention patterns and states asymptotic normality under additional assumptions.
The paper advertises confidence intervals for individual treatment effects and more general bilinear treatment-effect functionals under staggered adoption.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Re-index the model by admissible parameter tuples (L_n,D_n), define the observed experiment as P_Omega_n Y_n, and take the honesty/risk infimum and supremum over those tuples rather than over laws of full Y_n alone.

Replace the WSVD prose with a deterministic chart-overlap graph, a specified Procrustes/synchronization objective and gauge, an explicit Gaussian covariance/quantile, and a computable remainder; add the graph connectivity or spectral-gap condition actually needed by that construction.
Develop the overlap-aligned packing into a matched general-wedge converse, or identify a structural subclass where the packing is provably valid and quantify precisely when Rgeom_n is minimax-sharp.

recommended_next_step: Revise the statistical experiment and fully specify WSVD, then advance the distinct field-grade nuclear-radius kernel to Stage 0.
